title: Raw rational scalar square from its integral scalar square
statement: Fix prime l, finite coefficient extensions E,L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E→L, a simultaneous integral comparison system S, f:Y→X with l invertible, automorphisms eX,eY, and eY f=f eX. Suppose the prescribed integral automorphism square obeys the scalar-extension equation. Then its prescribed raw rational square obeys the identical equation with the rational pullback scalar comparisons and raw rational scalar extension [lem-sf-automorphism-constructible-stage-equivalence, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-rationalization-karoubi].

source.place: First paragraph, composition and coefficient extension of pullbacks

proof.text: Use the object formulas for raw rational pullback and scalar extension to identify every endpoint with the localization of its integral counterpart. The chosen rational square component and both scalar comparison components are localized integral components. On localized integral arrows, the prescribed pure-tensor maps at scalar one commute with localization.

proof.text: Compose the heterogeneous component equalities using the endpoint identifications. Functoriality identifies the resulting composites with localization applied to the integral scalar equation. Apply that equation and cancel the endpoint identifications. Identity extensions and zero objects obey the same argument.

    (f : Y ⟶ X) (eX : Aut X) (eY : Aut Y)
    (h : eY.hom ≫ f = f ≫ eX.hom)
    (hi : ∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X,
      (integralScalarExtension l E L ι Y).map
          ((automorphismStageIntegralSquare l E S f eX eY h).hom.app K).hom ≫
        (integralPullbackScalarComparison l E L ι f

        (integralDerivedPullback l L f).map

      (integralPullbackScalarComparison l E L ι eY.hom
          ((constructibleIntegralPullback l E f).obj K)).hom.hom ≫
        (integralDerivedPullback l L eY.hom).map

        ((automorphismStageIntegralSquare l L S f eX eY h).hom.app
          ((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension 0 l
            (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) E L ι X).obj K)).hom) :
    ∀ K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X,
      (sfRationalScalarExtension l E Y 0
        (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime)) L ι).map
          ((automorphismStageRationalSquare l E S f eX eY h).hom.app K) ≫
        (rationalPullbackScalarComparison l E L ι f).hom.app
          ((rationalDerivedPullback l E eX.hom).obj K) ≫
        (rationalDerivedPullback l L f).map
          ((rationalPullbackScalarComparison l E L ι eX.hom).hom.app K) =
      (rationalPullbackScalarComparison l E L ι eY.hom).hom.app
          ((rationalDerivedPullback l E f).obj K) ≫
        (rationalDerivedPullback l L eY.hom).map
          ((rationalPullbackScalarComparison l E L ι f).hom.app K) ≫
        (automorphismStageRationalSquare l L S f eX eY h).hom.app
